regimeNotes: REGIME DOWNGRADED risk-on -> NEUTRAL on 2026-09-01 (5 days after the 2026-08-27 risk-on upgrade). The single pillar of that upgrade -- a 'decisive dovish Fed pivot' -- has REVERSED. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh gave a hawkish speech flagging inflation worries; prediction markets (Kalshi) now price ~48 pct odds of a 25 bp HIKE in September, versus ~70 pct odds of no-change a week earlier. US CPI is at a 3-year high, pushed up by energy from the unresolved Middle East / Strait of Hormuz conflict (Brent near 90, WTI ~82; EIA sees Mideast output depressed until early 2027). Rates: 10Y steady ~4.22-4.24 pct but the policy path has flipped from easing to hike-risk. Equities: SPY 767.05 (~flat vs 766 on 8/27), S&P 500 ~7,686, but stalled at highs with a down Friday (Dow -0.7 pct) -- toppy, not broken. Mega-cap mixed since 8/27: MSFT 496 -> 507, NVDA 223 -> 220.78, GOOGL 342 -> 339.35. Crypto rolled over: total mcap 2.69T -> 2.625T, BTC 79,434 -> 78,199 (-1.6 pct), ETH 2,505 -> 2,439 (-2.6 pct), SOL 104.79 -> 102.77; Fear & Greed 71 -> 62 (still 'Greed'); BTC dominance ~59.7 pct (elevated = defensive tilt within crypto). Not risk-off: no growth scare, no credit stress, equities near record highs, VIX not spiking. But the risk asymmetry has clearly worsened -> NEUTRAL with a cautious lean. NAV 110,161.84 USD, -0.57 pct vs 8/27's 110,791.61, still +10.16 pct since inception and ahead of the ~33 pct CAGR pace. Portfolio action today: the neutral regime lowers the crypto sleeve cap from 35 pct back to 20 pct; the sleeve sat at 22.3 pct of NAV, so 2 guardrail-driven trims -- SOLD all SOL (11.242 @ 102.77, 1155.34 USD) and SOLD 0.5592 ETH (@ 2438.99, 1363.88 USD, taking profit into a +46 pct gain) -- bring the sleeve exactly to the 20 pct cap. BTC core left untouched. Cash rises 12.6 pct -> 14.9 pct, welcome optionality against a hawkish Fed + oil tail. MSFT remains the largest position at 17.5 pct NAV (above the 15 pct entry cap, below the ~20 pct drift-trim trigger -- HOLD, no add); BTC 15.9 pct similarly. No equity invalidation level is near. Equity book (quality AI/cloud + defensive UNH + GLD hedge) held intact -- these are durable compounders and the GLD/UNH ballast is exactly right for a stagflation-lean tape.
